answer.text: Yes, you may terminate the lease early by providing at least sixty (60) days prior written notice and paying an early termination fee equal to one (1) month of rent.

citations.quote: early termination fee equal to one (1) month rent upon sixty (60) days notice
citations.claim: Early departure requires 60 days notice and one month fee.

answers.query: what happens if rent is late

answer.text: Rent is due on the 1st of each month with a 5-day grace period. If payment is not received by the 5th business day, a late charge of $50.00 USD is assessed.

citations.quote: A grace period of five (5) business days is permitted. If rent is not received by the fifth (5th) business day, Tenant shall pay a late charge of $50.00 USD.
citations.claim: 5-day grace period permitted; $50 late charge applies on the 6th day.
